content.value: An urban planner has found the regression equation of Y on X from 20 pairs (09) of data to be $\dot { Y } = 2 5 . 0 0 + 0 . 5 0 X$ . He also computed the standard error of Y on X is 1.20. standard deviation of X is 2.00 also standard deviation of Y is 2.50. Test the hypothesis at 5% level of significance that the regression coefficient of population·is as low as 0.30.
